source.name: Kaizen Gaming, 'Betano and FC Porto renew partnership until 2029' (Main Sponsor, logo on the front of the official match and training shirts)
source.quote: The renewed agreement ensures Betano's continued presence on the front of the official match and training shirts of FC Porto's First Team and B Team.
source.note: Same announcement: 'Betano, Kaizen Gaming's premium online sports betting and gaming brand, will continue as FC Porto's Main Sponsor until the end of the 2028/29 season.'

source.name: Super Bock - Football (We team up with... FC Porto), plus Wikipedia 2026-27 Primeira Liga Personnel and kits (Porto row: Back Super Bock)
source.quote: We team up with... FC Porto
source.note: Super Bock's own football page lists FC Porto under 'We team up with...' ('A partnership of champions with a Northeastern accent'). The back-of-shirt slot for 2026-27 is documented by the Wikipedia season page's Personnel and kits table, Porto row: 'Back: Super Bock'; its sleeves in UEFA matches carry Super Bock instead of XTB.

source.name: FC Porto, 'FC Porto and XTB announce partnership through 2028/29' (Official Investment Partner, sleeve of the men's first-team shirt)
source.quote: FC Porto and XTB have signed a three-year partnership running through the end of the 2028/29 season.
source.note: Same announcement: XTB becomes the Club's new Official Investment Partner 'and will feature on the sleeve of the men's first-team shirt in all domestic competitions.' Wikipedia's 2026-27 Primeira Liga Personnel and kits table confirms XTB on the sleeves domestically, with Super Bock worn there in UEFA matches.

source.name: FC Porto, 'A tribute to the 1980s: here is FC Porto's new 2026-27 kit' (home kit produced in partnership with New Balance)
source.quote: The new Futebol Clube do Porto kit for the 2026/27 season, once again produced in partnership with New Balance,
source.note: Kit maker, named by the club as the producer of the 2026/27 kit; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: New Balance home shirt: Betano on the front (Main Sponsor until 2028/29), Super Bock on the back, XTB on the sleeve in domestic competitions (Super Bock there in UEFA matches). Betano is Kaizen Gaming (private Greek/Czech owners, partly Allwyn), Super Bock Group sits with the Violas family (56% VIACER) and Carlsberg (44%), XTB S.A. is Warsaw-listed with private investor Jakub Zabłocki as dominant shareholder; no state owner found in any chain.
